title: A cell thermal screen does not close full-fabric heat or volume
statement: Known star routing and balanced<=1A positive current per requested net give squared-current sum<=1A2 for two terminals and<=2A2 for at least three. Finite16-terminal compositions maximize10A2, giving .408488W on-cell heat before rails. Two20uL pockets per120 cells consume4.8mL,30.72% of a25mm cube before other hardware. US20170115354A1 is only the stated compensated-switch test read; TWI257115B/US6750594B2 family exposes metadata/abstract only and is held. No packed device, measured compensation or cost advantage follows.
